title: Silver zeolite methanol dehydrogenation experiments
question: How do catalyst descriptors and reactor settings relate to conversion and selectivity?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Palkovits, Regina; Simitsis, Natalia (RWTH Aachen University); Mebrahtu, Chalachew (RWTH Aachen University); Müller, Felix (RWTH Aachen University); Zobel, Mirijam (Forschungszentrum Jülich)
measurement_dates: Instrument headers include 2023 measurements (for example physisorption on 2023-02-17); complete campaign dates not asserted. Released 2025-06-18; deposited 2025-06-20.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Catalyst batch and full reactor run/condition.
validation_design: Catalyst batch and full reactor run/condition. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Source characterization includes instrument reductions, baseline-corrected products and figure-oriented catalytic tables alongside some raw exports. Instrument headers preserve original units and sample identifiers.
prior_analysis_and_limits: DOI 10.1039/d5cy00544b already reports Ag/Hbeta-catalyzed methanol dehydrogenation. Multiple characterizations of one catalyst are not independent catalysts. A broad claim needs additional synthesis batches; original 7z is retained without a duplicate extracted tree. Ag-zeolite characterization and reactor measurements in original 7z; source publication already analyzes activity/selectivity.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
